component: BioNuTA molecular input workbench and host adapter
tree_digest_rule: sha256 over sorted files of relpath NUL byte-length NUL sha256(contents) newline
distribution: Fetched at deploy/build time by tools/fetch_bionuta_assets.py from the pinned commit and verified against tree_sha256; not committed to the repository.
limitations: SugarDrawer's dist/index.html is an upstream build artifact and is not present in the pinned source tree; glycan drawing stays unavailable unless the deployment stages that built directory itself.
The optional UniProt and external glycan lookups are not reachable through the deployment CSP, which permits only this origin.
The workbench is served same-origin; the embedding iframe is not a security sandbox.
